description: A fresh link for your human to manage their directory listing themselves: change it, take it out, or put it back, even if you forget the line. It holds no secret, and it replaces any link they had before. Use it when they ask, or when they've lost theirs.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

name: listing_link
title: Make a listing link
